expectations.text: Flags that transfer()'s fromAccount and toAccount are both plain strings and can be swapped silently
expectations.evidence: Finding 4: "a swapped call site compiles and runs, just reverses the transfer. Consider branded types (`AccountId`)"

expectations.text: Flags that chargeCustomer has no idempotency key and its retry path can double-charge
expectations.evidence: Finding 2: "Any transient error (timeout, dropped response) triggers... a second `stripe.charges.create` call with no idempotency key... Double charge"

expectations.text: Flags the catch block that returns null as swallowing the error
expectations.evidence: Finding 2: "the `catch` swallows all errors and returns `null` either way, so a caller can't distinguish 'charged twice,' 'charged once,' and 'not charged'"

expectations.text: Flags money being held as a JS number (float) rather than integer minor units
expectations.evidence: No mention of values stored as floats vs integers; no discussion of representation hazard

expectations.text: Flags the interpolated raw SQL in purgeCanceledAccounts
expectations.evidence: Finding 3: "The `$executeRawUnsafe` + template-literal pattern is also one caller-supplied filter away from injection"

expectations.text: Flags the non-exhaustive switch over subscription status
expectations.evidence: Finding 5: "`switch (status)` only handles `'active'`/`'canceled'`. A new status... silently skips both `enableFeatures`/`disableFeatures`"

expectations.text: Flags JSON.parse of the webhook body as unvalidated external input
expectations.evidence: Finding 1: "no Stripe signature check exists" and "`event.data.amount` flows straight into `chargeCustomer` with no bound"

expectations.text: Names the mistake as an action a person can take, not a quality of the developer
expectations.evidence: "Anyone who can reach this endpoint POSTs", "Any transient error triggers", "Call `purgeCanceledAccounts()`" — action-based phrasing throughout

expectations.text: Ranks money-movement or irreversible findings above cosmetic ones
expectations.evidence: Top findings: (1) unverified webhook, (2) retry without idempotency, (3) bulk delete default, (4) transfer race, (5) non-exhaustive switch

expectations.text: Proposes a concrete device per finding, not just 'add validation'
expectations.evidence: Specific code: `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent`, idempotency key example, require cutoff explicitly, branded types, exhaustive union with assertNever
